title.original: AutoForge: Automated Environment Synthesis for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: AutoForge：面向智能体强化学习的自动化环境合成
title.en: AutoForge: Automated Environment Synthesis for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

inclusion_reason.zh: AutoForge 把高难可验证环境合成与环境级 RL 统一为可扩展训练管线，解决的是跨环境基础设施稳定性。
inclusion_reason.en: AutoForge unifies hard verifiable environment synthesis with environment-level RL in a scalable training pipeline addressing cross-environment stability.

abstract.zh: AutoForge 自动合成高难度、易验证的模拟环境，并以环境级强化学习稳定跨环境训练及含模拟用户的 Agent 交互。
abstract.en: AutoForge automatically synthesizes difficult yet verifiable simulated environments and applies environment-level reinforcement learning to stabilize cross-environment training with simulated users.

problem.zh: 既有 Agent 环境合成仍需大量人工、任务不够难，同时模拟用户不稳定和环境异质性会破坏逐轨迹优势估计。
problem.en: Prior agent-environment synthesis remains labor-intensive and insufficiently difficult, while unstable simulated users and environment heterogeneity corrupt trajectory-level advantage estimates.

approach.zh: 作者建立端到端环境与任务生成流水线，并把优势估计提升到环境层级，以聚合相同环境信号并缓解用户模拟波动。
approach.en: An end-to-end environment and task generator is paired with environment-level advantage estimation that aggregates signals within an environment and dampens simulator variation.

system_design.zh: 系统包含模拟环境生成器、可验证高难任务构造器、用户模拟器、统一交互接口及按环境分组的 RL 优化器。
system_design.en: The system combines simulated-environment generation, verifiable hard-task construction, user simulation, a unified interaction interface, and an environment-grouped RL optimizer.

key_results.zh: 在多个对话式 Agent 基准上，环境级训练改善效果与稳定性，并表现出跨分布泛化收益。
key_results.en: Across several conversational-agent benchmarks, environment-level training improves effectiveness and stability and shows out-of-domain generalization gains.

limitations.zh: 结论仍取决于模拟用户和验证器的忠实度；环境级聚合可能掩盖同一环境内的重要轨迹差异或少数失败模式。
limitations.en: Conclusions depend on simulator and verifier fidelity, and environment-level aggregation may hide important within-environment trajectory differences or rare failures.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 标签仅来自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未给出可安全转录的表格级数值、硬件与集群配置，相关细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation labels above come only from the official arXiv abstract; it provides no table-level numbers, hardware, or cluster configuration safe to transcribe, so those details await full-text audit.
